comment: Allowlist for scripts/security/engine_review.py binary (docs/security/engine-supply-chain.md, C5): the Windows CUDA build of upstream Strata's engine (strata.exe, strata_kq.dll). imports: DLLs the binaries may import. loadable: further DLL names they may carry and load at run time. A name outside both lists, any network library, or any process-launch / remote-thread / network / service / registry-write function fails the gate. Recorded 2026-10-21 from the v0.2.2 build (out/engine-cuda-v0.2.2); a change needs a ruling in the bump's review file.

loadable_rulings.nvcuda.dll: the NVIDIA driver API, opened by the CUDA runtime
loadable_rulings.nvcudart_hybrid64.dll: named by the statically linked CUDA 13 runtime
loadable_rulings.nvldumd.dll: NVIDIA user-mode driver loader, named by the static CUDA runtime in strata_kq.dll to locate the driver
loadable_rulings.strata_kq.dll: the engine's own K-quant MMQ library, loaded by full path from the engine folder (engine-protocol-limits.md)
